items.t: Can CVS Health's 2028 Split Unlock Value Despite Execution Risks?
items.sum: CVS Health's planned 2028 split aims to sharpen strategic focus, improve capital allocation and unlock growth, but execution costs and operational risks remain.

items.t: Wells Fargo Maintains Overweight on CVS Health, Lowers Price Target to $112
items.sum: Wells Fargo analyst Stephen Baxter maintains CVS Health (NYSE:CVS) with a Overweight and lowers the price target from $123 to $112.

items.t: CVS Beat Earnings by 27% and Split in Two, and Elizabeth Warren Says She Is Not Fooled
items.sum: CVS delivered a blowout quarter, then announced a breakup that Senator Warren called a surrender. But the split leaves the very pieces she targets under one roof, and one filing could settle who is right.
